messages:
eli: Heads-up — I opened a PR that splits the authz module into authz-core + authz-aws and pins provider versions. CI/staging plan errored out, looking for a quick sanity check before I iterate. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412

marta: link? I can peek. is this just provider pinning + secretpath moves?

eli: yep, mostly provider pins + small tfstate path rename for service-account secret. failing plan shows a lockfile/provider mismatch:
```
Error: provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws 3.47.0 does not match lockfile (2.9.2)
  on .terraform.lock.hcl line 12, in provider:
  provider "registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws"
```

samir: sounds like the lockfile needs regen after the module split. Did you run terraform init -upgrade or our lock regen script?

eli: I ran init but not the regen script. I didn’t want to accidentally move a bunch of other modules' pins.

deploy-bot: [automated] staging/plan failed for branch authz-split (job 243). See CI logs: https://ci.redwood/243/logs — provider version mismatch reported.

marta: if it's only the new modules, we can run the lock regen scoped to the workspace: `scripts/regen-lockfile.sh --modules authz-core,authz-aws --workspace=staging` — that should avoid unrelated churn.

samir: alternatively you can add an aliased provider temporarily to match lockfile while we regen:
```hcl
provider "aws" {
  region = var.region
}

provider "aws" {
  alias  = "payments"
  region = var.payments_region
}

module "authz-aws" {
  source = "../authz-aws"
  providers = { aws = aws.payments }
}
```

eli: good tip. the other part: I moved the k8s secret path for the sa key from modules/iam/sa -> modules/authz-core/secret. Did we have anything that depends on the old path?

marta: quick grep shows two places: `module/payments` (read-only) and an opa test harness in infra-tests. payments is fine (reads via output), infra-tests needs an update.

ops-ci: ran a scoped plan against staging after applying alias suggestion: `terraform plan -target=module.authz-core -var-file=staging.tfvars`
```
Plan: 1 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
+ resource: kubernetes_secret.authz_sa (new)
```

eli: nice — that's exactly what I expected. I'll run the scoped regen and push a follow-up. can someone review the lockfile change when i open it? don't want accidental bumps elsewhere. :pray:

marta: I can review. if regen touches unrelated modules, revert and run the scoped script.

samir: also add a short note in the PR description about why provider pins changed and include the `terraform providers lock` command you ran. helps audits.

eli: will do. thanks all — pushing updates now. :rocket:
